curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the polished and mysterious Ben casually confides an unusual hobby, a chilling sense of unease begins to warp Jong-su's world.
curatedMovie.description: When deliveryman Jong-su reconnects with Hae-mi, her return from Africa introduces him to an enigmatic man named Ben and his unusual hobby.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A patient, slow-burn psychological mystery with heavy emotional gravity, built for deep solitary focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Lee Chang-dong crafts an engrossing, deliberate mystery where quiet observation breeds unsettling dread, drawing tension out of every glance and whispered confession.
